# Task transform: repaint the largest 4-connected component of color 2 using the sparse marker color.
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps_for(color):
        seen=set(); comps=[]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen: continue
                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:

                comps.append(comp)
        return comps
    targets=comps_for(2)
    if not targets: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target=max(targets,key=len)
    marker_scores=[]
    for color,n in counts.items():
        if color in (bg,2): continue
        for comp in comps_for(color):
            rr=[p[0] for p in comp]; cc=[p[1] for p in comp]
            bh=max(rr)-min(rr)+1; bw=max(cc)-min(cc)+1

                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:

                out.append(comp)

        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if r0==r1 or c0==c1: return False
        s=set(comp)
        # Two adjacent full boundary arms, with no other pixels.
        for hor in (r0,r1):
            for ver in (c0,c1):
                lshape={(hor,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r,ver) for r in range(r0,r1+1)}
                if s==lshape: return True

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row); bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps(color):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c]!=color or (r,c) in seen: continue
                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                            seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
                out.append(comp)
        return out
    cues=[]
    for color in counts:
        if color==bg: continue
        for co in comps(color):
            rs=[r for r,c in co]; cs=[c for r,c in co]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if r0==r1 or c0==c1: continue
            s=set(co)
            for cr in (r0,r1):
                for cc in (c0,c1):
                    lshape={(cr,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1)} | {(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1)}
                    if s==lshape:
                        vr=1 if cr==r0 else -1 # direction of vertical arm
                        hc=1 if cc==c0 else -1 # direction of horizontal arm
                        cues.append((len(co),color,co,cr,cc,vr,hc,r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1))
    if not cues: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,cue_color,cue,cr,cc,vr,hc,ch,cw=max(cues,key=lambda x:x[0])
    want=(ch-2,cw-2)
    candidates=[]
    for color in counts:
        if color in (bg,cue_color,0): continue
        cc_list=comps(color)
        for co in cc_list:
            rs=[r for r,c in co]; cs=[c for r,c in co]
            rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            # In or touching the diagonal quadrant opposite the two L arms.
            inopp=((rmin<=cr) if vr>0 else (rmax>=cr)) and ((cmin<=cc) if hc>0 else (cmax>=cc))
            dims=(rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1)
            dd=abs(dims[0]-want[0])+abs(dims[1]-want[1])
            dist=((sum(r for r,c in co)/len(co)-cr)**2+(sum(c for r,c in co)/len(co)-cc)**2)**.5
            candidates.append((dd, not inopp, len(co)/((rmax-rmin+1)*(cmax-cmin+1)), -dist, color, co, 'component'))
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(cc_list)>1:
            rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
            dims=(max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
            dd=abs(dims[0]-want[0])+abs(dims[1]-want[1])
            dist=((sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells)-cr)**2+(sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)-cc)**2)**.5
            candidates.append((dd, True, len(cells)/(dims[0]*dims[1]),-dist,color,cells,'global'))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Exact frame-size matches are strongest; among them favor the opposite side and non-solid patterns.
    exact=[x for x in candidates if x[0]==0]
    if exact:
        # Preserve the color group for a disconnected glyph if its aggregate bounding box is the exact fit.
        exact.sort(key=lambda x:(x[1], x[2]==1, -x[3], len(x[5])))
        chosen=exact[0]
    else:
        opposite=[x for x in candidates if not x[1]]
        pool=opposite or candidates
        chosen=min(pool,key=lambda x:(x[0], -x[3], x[1], len(x[5])))
    target=chosen[5]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target: out[r][c]=cue_color
    return out
